messages:
Tia: Hey folks — I need to swap my Sat night -> Sun morning oncall block (Sat 20:00 UTC -> Sun 08:00 UTC). Flight changed last minute. Can someone cover Sat 22:00->Sun 06:00? I can take Sun 06:00->12:00 instead. :airplane:
Kevin: I can do the 22:00->02:00 slice if that helps. Quick Q: any scheduled deploys or infra ops during that window?
Tia: No customer-facing deploys planned. There is a planned infra maintenance window in us-east on Sun 02:00-03:00 UTC (node reboots for driver updates). Infra team said it should be safe but could cause transient model restarts and cache warmup.
Morgan: I can cover 02:00->06:00 if Kevin takes the earlier bit — that would full-cover Sat 22->Sun 06. @Tia is there a handoff note I should be aware of (hot endpoints, recent regressions)?
Tia: Thanks both — that works. Handoff notes: 1) Watch the /v1/health and /v1/models endpoints after 02:00 reboots. 2) If any model worker fails to come up, rollback plan is to switch routing to model-variant: rdx-small for 15m while infra recovers. 3) Cache warmup: prefix caching will be empty after restart; expect ~20% latency spike for first ~5k reqs. 4) Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/oncall-handoff (section: weekend-bridge).
Kevin: Got it. Can you paste the rollback command snippet?
Tia: Sure — run this from ops CLI: ```ops route set --model rdx-small --policy emergency --duration 15m --reason "infra reboot failover"``` Also check deploy-bot logs: `/var/log/deploy-bot.log` if model/container issues show up.
infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance: us-east node-driver-update starting 2067592800 (Sun 02:00 UTC). Expected duration 3600s. Contact infra-pager for escalation.
Morgan: I'll take 02:00->06:00 and will monitor health + open a short handoff thread 30m before the shift ends. Kevin — DM me your pager to confirm handoff.
Tia: Thanks so much. I'll update the rota and remove myself for Sat 22:00->Sun 06:00. Leaving a note in the rota: "Tia -> Kevin (22-02), Morgan (02-06), Tia (06-12). Flight info + contact in personal note." :white_check_mark:
